'''Helleguth''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Helleguth system/Legends|Helleguth system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] intended to bring the criminal [[T'mott Zoat]] there, to stand trial for his crimes. One of those crimes was the murder of a woman named [[Jesef]] in [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]], who Obi-Wan Kenobi failed to protect.<ref name="The Smuggler's Code">''[[The Clone Wars: The Smuggler's Code]]''</ref>
